policy: Mode-specific access, barriers and oneway; full node/edge national clipping; node-via turn restrictions; complex via-way restrictions avoided. Shortest distance, not traffic-aware fastest route. Time-dependent/reversible direction ways omitted. Bicycles on motorroad require explicit permission.
limitations: Conditional access ways excluded; conditional turn restrictions applied conservatively at all times. Destination/private access excluded. OSM may be incomplete. Not field verified; no traffic or live closures.
